content:
sophia: Hey finance — Velora Networks sent invoice #VL-8642 but there is NO PO on it. It got routed to mike_fin for approval but procurement should own PO matching for this vendor. Invoice PDF: https://redwood-drive/finance/invoices/VL-8642.pdf

approvals-bot: Invoice imported (id=inv_20240312_2987). Flags: `no_po`. Routed to mike_fin (finance-team) per default vendor rules.

mike_fin: Thanks — I pulled the PDF. Invoice total is $12,330. I don't see a PO number. Can someone confirm vendor entity and whether a PO exists? Also what GL should this hit?

sophia: Vendor entity = Velora Networks (vendor id: VEL-009). The PDF shows "PO #: —" and service dates 02/15–02/28. From contract notes it looks like this should've referenced PO 2227 but vendor omitted it.

procurement-bot: Found matching open PO 2227 for Velora Networks (committed amount: $9,900). Three-way match failed: invoice_amount ($12,330) != committed_amount ($9,900). Tagging @tanvi for procurement review.

tanvi: I'm taking this. If PO 2227 is the intended match, vendor billed $2,430 extra (unapproved hours). We need confirmation from ops on whether those additional charges were authorized. @april_ops can you confirm?

april_ops: Not approved on my side. No change order on record. Please HOLD payment and request corrected invoice or credit memo referencing PO #2227. GL: use `6102` (Contracted Services) for the base PO amount; variance to be held pending vendor response.

mike_fin: Placing invoice on hold in AP system (status: HOLD_INV_1945678901) and adding comment: "missing PO + amount discrepancy". Re-routing approval to procurement. Next steps: procurement to request corrected invoice or PO amendment.

tanvi: We'll ask vendor AR to re-issue invoice referencing PO 2227 or submit a credit memo. If vendor insists on extra hours, they must provide scope addendum signed by ops. Target: vendor response by EOD tomorrow.

sophia: I'll draft vendor outreach. Template: "Please reference PO #2227 or submit a credit memo for $2,430. Include line-level breakdown and service dates." Will send to ar@velora.com now.

mike_fin: Added comment in AP: 
```
Action: HOLD_INV
Reason: Missing PO; invoice > PO by $2,430. Contact vendor AR: ar@velora.com. Req: corrected invoice or credit memo. Approver reroute to procurement.
```
:thumbsup:

approvals-bot: Re-route complete — invoice flagged to #procurement and assigned to tanvi. audit_id: ar_9071

tanvi: I'll update the thread once vendor responds. If no response by EOD+1 we escalate to vendor manager. :eyes:
